scripts.clean: bun -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p=['.turbo','node_modules/.cache'];for(const d of ['apps','packages']){if(fs.existsSync(d))for(const x of fs.readdirSync(d))p.push(d+'/'+x+'/.turbo',d+'/'+x+'/.next',d+'/'+x+'/node_modules/.cache')}for(const x of p)fs.rmSync(x,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('clean: removed',p.length,'paths')"
scripts.ci: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run check-types && bun run test && bun run check:env-isolation && bun run build
